verdict.rationale: The project documents a one-command install through Claude Code's official marketplace (`claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`) as a managed, auto-updating bundle. It also documents an installer that writes editable skill files into the project, with `npx skills update` for updates. The site says you install the skills and then type a slash command, which implies they are usable right away. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or hands-on confirmation that the skills are active in the next session, the exact one-liner for the npx/editable-copy route (only the update command is quoted), and independent corroboration that the marketplace install works as described.
